original_question: On which chromosome is the ryanodine receptor gene which mediates calcium release in cardiac muscle and can cause catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia when mutated?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the ryanodine receptor gene which mediates calcium release in cardiac muscle and can cause catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia when mutated?
final_qi.long_answer: The cardiac ryanodine receptor gene (RYR2) lies on chromosome 1 (band 1q43). Mutations in RYR2 disrupt calcium release from the sarcoplasmic reticulum in cardiomyocytes, predisposing to catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia.
